description: Returns one market by market_id or by slug. Pass exactly one of them. A slug is the last path segment of a Polymarket event URL, as in https://polymarket.com/event/<slug>, and the whole URL works too. Use it to resolve a Polymarket link or to read the full record of a market, including token ids and resolution fields. Costs 1 API request.

market_id.description: PolyTest market id. Pass this or slug, not both.

slug.description: A Polymarket event URL, or its last path segment. Pass this or market_id, not both.

name: polytest_get_market

price_end.description: Coin spot price when the window closed. Null until it is recorded.

price_start.description: Coin spot price when the window opened.

status.description: upcoming: not started. open: the window is still running. resolved: the winner is known. ended_no_result: the window closed and PolyTest has no result for it.

winner.description: Winning side once the market resolves. A tie resolves Up.

title: Get market
